description: This Java class, ICalRecurConverter, converts proprietary Temporal Expressions into iCalendar recurrence rules and properties. It implements the TemporalExpressionVisitor interface to traverse various temporal expression types and produce corresponding iCalendar recurrence rules, date lists, and exclusion rules. The class supports conversion of complex recurrence patterns like differences, intersections, day ranges, month ranges, and frequency-based expressions, with some limitations noted for certain features like substitutions.

classes.name: ICalRecurConverter
classes.description: A converter class that maps complex TemporalExpression objects into iCalendar recurrence rules and date properties, enabling recurrence pattern translation for calendar events. Implements the visitor pattern for different expressions and consolidates recurrence rules accordingly.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Static method to convert a TemporalExpression into iCalendar properties for an event, updating the provided PropertyList with recurrence rules and dates based on the expression.

methods.name: consolidateRecurs
methods.description: Consolidates a list of Recur objects into a single Recur object with combined frequency and constraints for simplified recurrence representation.
